_doc: Every object (ontology Entity line) of every module, with its canonical lifecycle (lifecycles.json), the state and command mapping (src/objects_map.json), the mechanisms it uses (src/mechanisms_src.json instances) and the axioms those implement. Built by semantics/tools/build_semantics.py; the object list is derived from the ontology, not by hand. Module 00 declares no entity (its statements are the axioms' sources).

objects.reason: The four states (empty, ordinary name, the name 0, a control character) are classes of an input value, fixed when the caller writes the name: nothing moves a name from one class to another. Validity is a refusal at every entry (AX-03, M-09 law M09-L1), independent of whether the graph the name designates is empty or live, so no canonical state applies; the commands are mapped onto the scope lifecycle LC-6 of the graph the name designates.
